get.description: Get a paginated list of all connections accessible to your organization.

post.description:
Create a new connection.

This will validate the credentials with the TSP before creating the connection.
If the credentials are invalid, the connection will not be created and an error will be returned.

It also creates a schedule to refresh or exchanged the coneection details
for a short lived credential, shuch as an access token.

x-mint.content: <Info>Creating connections is only available to fleets.</Info>

get.description: Get detailed information about a specific connection.

patch.description:
Update a connection by its ID.

The repository handles validation, authentication, and SLC creation when credentials are updated.

x-mint.content: <Info>Updating connections is only available to fleets.</Info>

delete.description: Delete a connection by its ID.

x-mint.content: <Info>Deleting connections is only available to fleets.</Info>

get.description: Get a paginated list of all schedules for a given connection.

post.description:
Create a new schedule.

This will create a schedule to fetch data from the TSP.

It also creates a schedule to refresh or exchange the connection details
for a short lived credential, such as an access token.

For now only Catena admins can create schedules.

get.description: Get detailed information about a specific schedule.

patch.description: Update a schedule by its ID.

delete.description: Delete a schedule by its ID.

get.description: Get a paginated list of all executions for a given schedule.
